title: After the Mile Ch.: Settling the Storm

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Pant… pant…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: (I lost… I'm so sorry, Trainer…)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: …Okay. Time to head back.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Exhale…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: (Huh?)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: (I wonder what's wrong with Zephyr…)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: (Oh no, maybe she feels sick!)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Excuse me, Zephyr? Are you all right?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: …The wind.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I couldn't run like the wind… My body is still stuck here…

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Weighed down to this spot…

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: If I cannot grasp victory here, then how will I ever go beyond?!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: (I see… It's not that she's feeling unwell. She's heartsick over her loss.)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: (What should I do? I want to cheer her up, but I don't know what to say…)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: …I'm sorry. I shouldn't have taken that out on you.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Regardless, thank you. You've calmed the storm in my heart, somewhat.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Huh? But I didn't do anything…

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: …I suppose we'll be seeing each other next at the Takamatsunomiya Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Today, I was a frail breeze. But next time, I won't let anyone dictate my currents.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Zephyr…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I'm really disappointed in myself too. Let's do our best next time and leave no regrets behind!
